criteria.requirement: Add actual json Writer and doctree_json to_data/from_data/dumps/loads schema 1 for the declared supported standard node whitelist, preserving node type/rawsource/source/line/JSON attributes/child order/Unicode and rebuilding actual id/name maps. Real published JSON must round-trip into real Docutils nodes and publish through HTML with reference ids intact. Never pickle, deserialize arbitrary classes or serialize settings/reporter objects. Reject unknown schemas/nodes/extra shapes, invalid source/line/attributes, opaque/nonfinite values, duplicate ids, shared/cyclic nodes and explicit depth/node-budget overflow. Unsupported standard/custom nodes must fail explicitly rather than silently losing information; old XML/pseudoxml remain unchanged.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
